title: Recover ambiguous payment state without duplicate mutation

known_facts: One logical payment operation was initiated.
constraints: Do not create a second payment mutation while the first operation may already be committed.

tension.summary: The client needs a definitive next step while the financial side effect may already exist.

cause.summary: Transport ambiguity hides whether the existing logical operation already produced a committed financial effect.
supporting_signals: commit state is not locally known

transition.trigger: authoritative read of the existing logical operation
transition.expected_consequence: Resolve whether the existing payment effect committed without creating another mutation.

participants.name: payment client
participants.risk: blind retry creates a second effect

participants.name: transaction state source
participants.goal: report the authoritative state of the existing logical operation
participants.risk: stale or non-authoritative observations mislead recovery

cooperation.shared_upside: A single existing effect is accepted when proven, and unnecessary mutation is avoided.

action.summary: Read the authoritative state of the existing logical operation; do not create a new payment effect.
action.review_after: Immediately after the authoritative state read returns.

review.summary: Authoritative recovery found the existing committed effect; no second mutation was issued.
review.actual_consequence: The ambiguous operation resolved to one existing committed effect.
